title: Assertion: Data Frozen While Enabled
constraints: Rule: while `en` stays high (from the cycle after it rose until it falls), `data` must not change. Data may change in the cycle `en` rises.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `en && $past(en) |-> $stable(data)`: both this cycle and the previous one are enabled.
`$past` needs a previous sample. `disable iff (rst)` handles the start.
Alternative: `$rose(en) |=> $stable(data) throughout en[*0:$] …` is harder. Keep it simple.

examples.title: changed
examples.input: data changes in the 3rd enabled cycle

examples.check: legal: data loads as en rises
examples.title: load
examples.input: data changes in the rising cycle
